scripts.quality: bun run --cwd packages/waffle quality && bun run --cwd site typecheck
scripts.programs:routes: bun run --cwd packages/coreutils test:build-routes && bun run --cwd packages/grep test:build-route && bun run --cwd packages/findutils test:build-route && bun run --cwd packages/sed test:build-routes
scripts.programs:source: bun run --cwd packages/findutils test:source && bun run --cwd packages/sed test:source && bun run --cwd packages/ripgrep test:source
scripts.programs:tools: bun test tools/program-build-tools.test.ts tools/program-build-tools-verifier.test.ts tools/program-family-manifest.test.ts tools/family-acceptance.test.ts tools/program-package.test.ts tools/program-notices.test.ts packages/git/scripts/patch-git-source.test.ts packages/git/tests/program-strip.test.ts
scripts.programs:native: cargo test --locked --offline -p waffle-program-support -p waffle-process-consumer -p waffle-coreutils -p waffle-clear -p waffle-cut -p waffle-tr -p waffle-wc -p waffle-grep -p waffle-findutils-source -p upstream-xargs -p waffle-echo
scripts.programs:pack: bun run --cwd packages/coreutils pack && bun run --cwd packages/grep pack && bun run --cwd packages/findutils pack && bun run --cwd packages/sed pack && bun run --cwd packages/ripgrep pack && bun run --cwd packages/base pack
scripts.programs:check: bun run programs:prepare && bun run --cwd packages/waffle tsc -p ../../tools/tsconfig.programs.json
